history.contentIn: The alarming decline of Arctic sea ice is a dire threat to polar bears! These majestic creatures rely on sea ice to hunt seals, their primary food source. The International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) warns us that this loss is the biggest long-term danger to polar bears. As ice-free seasons stretch longer, these bears will face extended fasting periods and declining cub survival rates. While some claim that polar bears are thriving, this ignores the brutal reality they face due to disappearing ice.
